column1: # The API table of ddraw.dll: every export of DirectDraw, from the DDRAW.DLL of DirectX 5 (on POD Gold's disc, DIRECTX/)
# Written by tools/pe/apitable.py from the original's own code; the stub column was added by
# hand. wrappers/stubgen.py writes ddraw.def and src/stubs.rs from this file: each export this
# library does not implement yet becomes a stub that logs its call and returns `stub`.
# Columns: export name, Rust name, stdcall or cdecl, argument bytes (stdcall), parameter
# count (- unknown), return kind (int, void, float, - unknown), the stub's return value.
# Only the public calls: the DirectX 5 DDRAW.DLL's other exports (DDHAL32_*, VidMem*, the
# thunks) are its own internals. DirectDrawCreateEx and DirectDrawEnumerateEx (DirectX 7) come
# from ddraw.h (MinGW). Stubs return DDERR_UNSUPPORTED (0x80004001); DllCanUnloadNow S_FALSE
